steps.en: If the address did not change, system moves on to director lookup
steps.id: Jika alamat tidak berubah, sistem lanjut mencari data direktur
steps.why_en: No branch on address change exists, because address change is never detected.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada percabangan berdasar perubahan alamat, karena perubahan alamat tidak pernah terdeteksi.

steps.en: System sends the company UEN to the registry for officer data
steps.id: Sistem mengirim UEN perusahaan ke registry untuk data pejabat
steps.why_en: Works through a data hub not confirmed to be DOS; job is off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Lewat data hub yang belum terkonfirmasi sebagai DOS; job mati di setelan produksi.

steps.en: Results are filtered by offence date and appointment period
steps.id: Hasil disaring berdasarkan tanggal pelanggaran dan periode penunjukan
steps.why_en: The lookup uses the UEN only; no filter on offence date or appointment dates.
steps.why_id: Pencarian hanya memakai UEN; tidak ada filter tanggal pelanggaran atau penunjukan.

steps.en: Owner, partner and director details are saved
steps.id: Data pemilik, partner dan direktur disimpan
steps.why_en: Shareholders are saved for regular notices, but director saving is disabled.
steps.why_id: Pemegang saham disimpan untuk notice reguler, tetapi penyimpanan direktur dimatikan.
